observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: outdoor woodland setting at a public gathering or powwow with seated spectators lining the dance area
observation.dancers: group of male dancers of varying ages including adults, teenagers, and a young child
observation.formation_and_space: dancers move in a circular or semi-circular path around an open central performance space
observation.posture: upright torso with forward lean during lower lunges, knees bent and flexing with the beat
observation.footwork: fast stepping, alternating foot lifts, quick weight shifts, and crouching steps on the beat; exact heel-toe mechanics cannot be definitively seen due to camera angle and distance
observation.arms_and_hands: arms move actively with the rhythm, sometimes extended outward or holding fans and rattles
observation.hips_and_torso: torso remains upright or bends forward at the waist during crouches
observation.levels_jumps_turns: frequent level changes between upright standing and deep crouching or dropping low to the ground, with turning steps
observation.costume_and_props: traditional regalia including feathered headdresses, fringed outfits, tunics in various colors (red, yellow, orange, blue, green), beaded aprons, and moccasins
observation.cannot_infer: exact foot placement details and ankle mechanics are obscured by fast motion and video compression

signature_moments.what: dancers drop quickly into a low crouch while moving around the circle
rapid directional turns and knee lifts in a low center of gravity
fast rhythmic stepping while extending arms wide and shifting levels
